topic: Pick a spot for the department summer picnic

scenario.topic: Pick a spot for the department summer picnic
scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our summer picnic spot: convenience, activities, or atmosphere?

options.name: Riverside Park Picnic Area
options.upside: Free to use with scenic river views and playground for relaxing
options.tradeoff: No covered shelter if it rains and can get crowded on weekends
options.concern: Might be noisy due to other park visitors and nearby road traffic
options.best_for: prioritizing cost savings and outdoor ambiance

options.name: Sunnyvale Community Garden Pavilion
options.upside: Covered pavilion provides shade and shelter with a quiet garden setting
options.tradeoff: Reservation fee reduces budget for food and activities
options.concern: Limited parking and requires advance booking to secure spot

options.name: Lakeside Marina Picnic Spot

attrs.available_facilities: boat rentals, picnic tables, fishing pier

options.upside: Opportunity for boating and fishing adds fun activities beyond eating
options.tradeoff: Farthest location increases travel time and rental cost is highest
options.concern: Some group members may not want to participate in water activities
options.best_for: prioritizing recreational activities and quiet environment

options.name: Downtown Rooftop Garden
options.upside: Close location with unique city views and easy access to restaurants
options.tradeoff: Higher rental fee limits budget for food and extras
options.concern: Limited natural shade and potential noise from city traffic below

shared_context: The picnic is planned for a Saturday afternoon in July
